references.context: Complete both LITE LOCK target groups, then shoot the saucer once to lock one ball and ready the two-ball start.
references.label: 8-ball physical lock
references.description: The saucer at the top of the module feeds the physical lock, which can hold up to eight balls.

references.context: Use the yellow buttons to select Barroom Brawl, then shoot the right scoop to start it.
references.label: Mode scoop
references.description: The right scoop starts the selected story mode and Lights Out Multiball.

references.context: Complete both LITE LOCK target groups, then shoot the saucer once to lock one ball and ready the two-ball start.
references.label: LITE LOCK targets
references.description: The target groups on both sides of the module qualify balls for the saucer lock.

references.context: Repeat either ramp for Secret Agent Jackpots.
references.label: Secret Agent jackpot ramps
references.description: Both module ramps score Secret Agent Multiball jackpots.
